title: Fastlife

ai_content.desc_en: Fastlife: always go further, faster, to shine in the eyes of others. This is the motto of Franklin, a man consumed by the desire to shine at any price. However, Franklin's life takes a dramatic turn when he is faced with the choice of continuing his fast-paced life or becoming a mature individual.
